info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v5-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Document Retrieval API provides businesses with the capability to access and retrieve documents associated with insurance claims. This endpoint allows users to efficiently find the necessary claims documents, streamlining the claims process for insurance professionals and adjusters. Typical consumers include claims handlers, insurance auditors, and customer support representatives who need quick access to relevant documentation. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their workflow and improve the overall efficiency of insurance claim management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of claim documents.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve all documents related to claims. Use this to get the relevant documentation needed for each claim.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving documents related to claims. This body may contain specific details about the documents being requested, which will help in filtering and processing the retrieval effectively.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of documents associated with claims.
